Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1586

Open and save

  • New folder: the folder button on the path bar, or Shift-Cmd-N, makes "untitled folder" with its name ready to type over.
  • Right-click a file or folder for Open, Rename (F2, in place; Esc leaves it), Show in Finder, Move to Trash (Cmd-Backspace) and New folder.
  • A type menu beside the chips shows only Comps, Images, Movies, Audio, 3D or Everything; All types, or a chip, goes back. Sequences stay one row.

Plugins

  • More installed OpenFX plugins run: some only load in hosts they know, so Kento now introduces itself under a name they support. Neat Video 6 renders in Kento.
  • Settings > Performance > Processing: load the computer's OpenFX plugins, or only Kento's; and GPU for nodes that support it (plugins, Nagi, the optical flow), off for the CPU. Both from the next start.

Fixed

  • The chevron on a Properties panel's bar folds the panel again (it showed the drag hand instead).
  • The file dialog's Size column says 1 byte, not 1 bytes.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1579

OpenFX plugins

  • The OpenFX plugins installed on the computer run in Kento: Tab search lists them under Plugins by their own names, and a comp that uses one opens with it working. Each plugin's controls are its knobs, under its own labels. A plugin that's installed but won't run in Kento passes its input through, switched off, and opening the comp says so.

Node Graph

  • 3D nodes by kind: geometry the faceted hexagon, axes and cameras a glossy pill, lights a bulb, the Scene a doubled hexagon, and renders the plain box. A plugin's tile has a plug's two prongs.

3D viewer

  • It follows the comp as you work: wiring an object into the scene, or moving or scaling it, shows at once.
  • Axis nodes are drawn as small gizmos in the axis colors, to select and move with the handles.

Properties

  • Compact header bars, each panel closed by a dark line. Long tooltips wrap, the node's name bold over its description.
  • Channel menus on a layer other than rgba show that layer's channels. Projection's edges warning stops short of the overscan button.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1565

3D viewer

  • Tab over the Viewer (or Viewer > 3D view) shows the comp's 3D in the picture's place; Tab again gives the picture back. It shows the scene of what the Viewer shows: cards, spheres, cubes, cylinders and meshes where they render, each projection's camera, frustum and held image (in light blue), the comp's cameras as objects with an arrow along their view, a CameraTracker's solved points and the ground grid. The unconnected check adds the 3D nodes that aren't in the scene, faint.
  • Look from perspective, top, front, side, any camera or a projection's held camera. Alt-drag orbits, Alt-middle pans, Alt-right or the wheel zooms; F frames. W, E and R give the move, rotate and scale handles; a drag is one undo, and Cmd lands a move on a tracked point.

ScanlineRender

  • Motion blur: samples, shutter, shutter offset, custom offset and randomize time; textures move with the shutter too.
  • Depth of field: focus diameter keeps the camera's new focal point sharp. Sample diameter and stochastic samples.
  • Overscan gives the format plus the overscan on every side. Motion vector channels is a forward or motion menu.

Curve Editor and Dope Sheet

  • Knobs by their labels (Grade's gain), the name for expressions in the tooltip. Cmd-click or Cmd+Option-click a curve to key it; the curve under the pointer glows.
  • Tangent handles land on whole frames; Shift keeps them to one direction. Snap's settings are kept. A Roto's shape keys show in the list and the dope strip.
  • The board's details: values to three places, the gutter kept clear, the current ease lit, family colours on the Dope Sheet's nodes.

Panels

  • Properties: each panel's header is a bar with a grip. Drag it up or down to reorder; drag it out sideways to float the panel. Long labels are shortened, the full label in the tooltip.
  • Scopes to their board. The Flipbook player takes L, J, K, the arrow keys and O, and has its own page in Preferences > Shortcuts, as do Kento's other panels now.

Fixed

  • The Node Graph's wires no longer flicker while the graph sits idle.
